theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Huge Money To Start
body: Myth: You need lakhs to invest. Reality: Start with small amounts through systematic investment approaches.
caption: Many believe mutual fund investing requires significant capital upfront. In reality, flexible investment options allow you to begin with minimal amounts and grow gradually. Start your investment journey at your own pace. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingForEveryone #SmallStepsCount #MFEducation #BurstTheMyth
